Senior Backend Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team.

Responsibilities:
- Design and build scalable APIs and services
- Mentor junior engineers and review their code
- Own reliability and on-call for critical systems

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with Node.js or a similar backend stack
- Strong understanding of distributed systems and databases
- Experience mentoring or leading other engineers

Bonus points for:
- Experience with Kubernetes
- Contributions to open source projects
